annotations.title: Extract Section B CLIN Pricing Tables, Quotes & Labor Rate Cards

description: Extract multi-tier CLIN/SLIN pricing schedules, GSA/T&M labor rate cards, vendor quotes, and Bill of Materials (BOM) tables from unstructured text into normalized JSON with automated line-item math auditing. This is a read-only, stateless extraction call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `document_text` accepts 20 to 100,000 characters, `expected_document_type` optionally hints the table schema, and `audit_math_and_anomalies` [default true] verifies `quantity * unit_price == extended_price` and flags arithmetic discrepancies). Use this tool when parsing pricing tables, CLIN schedules, invoices, or labor rate cards; use `parse_b2b_contract` instead for general contract dates/parties/deliverables, or `search_historical_awards` to look up historical government award prices.

audit_math_and_anomalies.description: When true (default), cross-checks each line item (`quantity * unit_price == total_price`) and subtotal summation, returning any arithmetic mismatches in `math_discrepancies`.

document_text.description: Raw text or copied table content from a Federal Section B CLIN schedule, T&M labor rate card, B2B vendor quote, BOM, or invoice (20 to 100,000 characters).

expected_document_type.description: Document schema hint: 'auto_detect' (default), 'federal_section_b_clin_schedule' (parses Base/Option Year CLINs & contract types like FFP/T&M), 'gsa_or_tm_labor_rate_card' (LCAT hourly rates), 'b2b_vendor_quote_or_bom', or 'commercial_invoice'.

name: extract_pricing_schedule

calculated_grand_total.description: Verified sum of all extracted line items.

dominant_pricing_model.description: Primary contract pricing structure (e.g., FIRM_FIXED_PRICE_FFP, TIME_AND_MATERIALS_TM).

line_items.description: Normalized CLIN/line items with quantity, unit, unit_price, extended_price, and period.

math_discrepancies.description: Flagged arithmetic errors or rate anomalies when audit_math_and_anomalies is enabled.

title: Extract Section B CLIN Pricing Tables, Quotes & Labor Rate Cards
